items.title: US Markets Spotlight · DELL — a $132.3 billion backlog, and a share price cut in half
items.summary: Revenue of $54.94 billion (+103%) and adjusted EPS of $9.45 (+265%). AI server revenue rose 291% to $22 billion, $60.2 billion of new orders lifted the backlog to $132.3 billion, and guidance for the year went to $202 billion — the third raise this year. The stock still fell 11.83% the day before the print and could not hold a direction after it. The fourth-quarter guide lifts revenue 2.5% while cutting earnings per share by 11%.

items.title: US Markets Daily Report · November 25
items.summary: One day was enough to undo Monday. Semiconductors rolled over again, leaving the S&P 500 down 0.50% at 7,201.09 and the Nasdaq down 1.48% at 23,733.54. Nvidia fell 5.86%, handing back about half of its 31% gain, Micron lost 11.0% and AMD 8.9%, and the SOX dropped 7.88% with all thirty members lower. Anthropic closed at $81.91, below its $83 IPO price. The Dow rose 0.85% and the Russell 2000 added 0.7%. Talk of a new tariff round and a December rate hike weighed on sentiment, while the 10-year yield eased to 4.901%.

items.summary: Q3 revenue of CNY 14.182bn (+78.8%), net profit of CNY 3.44bn (+238.4%) and a 41.63% gross margin — all records. Yet the stock opened limit-up and closed up just 1.40%, and the CNY 340bn market value of May is now CNY 149.6bn. Here is what sits between a material that keeps getting more expensive and the 2027 demand that has to pay for it.

items.title: China AI Daily Report · November 24
items.summary: Jensen Huang's reinstatement sent US semis soaring overnight, but A-shares loaded the gain into the opening print and gave it back all day. Shanghai rose 0.27%, ChiNext touched +4% before closing 0.05% lower, and only the STAR 50 held on, up 1.81%. Optical modules and PCB names gave back 8–10% from their intraday highs, while domestic chips such as Cambricon (+6.03%), SMIC (+4.04%) and Hua Hong (+10.36%) kept their gains to the close.

items.title: US Markets Spotlight · MU — on the day Nvidia came back, memory had its best session ever
items.summary: Fiscal Q4 revenue of $54.23 billion (+379%), gross margin of 87.0%, EPS of $33.42 — a sixth straight record, with guidance of $61.5 billion for the next quarter. The stock was still 41.7% below its June high, then rose 19.04% on Nov. 23. Nothing new came from the company. With Jensen Huang back at Nvidia, confidence in AI capex returned, and the most heavily sold corner of the market bounced hardest. The numbers that decide what follows arrive on Dec. 17.

items.title: US Markets Daily Report · November 24
items.summary: Jensen Huang is back at Nvidia, and the AI trade came back with him. The board reinstated him 12 days after his resignation, Nvidia jumped 31.48%, and the Nasdaq rose 6.51% for its best day since April 2025. The S&P 500 gained 4.73% to 7,237.17 to end a seven-session slide, the Dow added 1,447.98 points (3.01%), the SOX climbed 13.98% and the VIX fell 26.04% to 26.54. The indexes are still below their highs, and Anthropic was the one AI name that fell.

items.summary: Q3 revenue of CNY 27.769bn (+171.8%) and net profit of CNY 8.587bn (+173.7%). In nine months it sold 1.8 times all of last year. Yet the shares sit at CNY 417.20, less than half their August level, and on Monday the board said it would pay up to CNY 600 to buy CNY 2–4bn of them. Here is the 2027 order book that sits between the company's price and the market's.

items.title: US Markets Spotlight · AVGO — the day Google cut its orders, Broadcom fell 12%
items.summary: Revenue of $29.59bn (+86%), AI semiconductors of $16.7bn (+221%), guidance of $34.8bn — a record quarter. Management gets to answer on December 9.
